column2: Crux Resolve GhostBridge GB-01 RS232-to-WiFi TCP Serial Bridge
column3: Assembled local RS232-to-WiFi TCP bridge optimized and verified for GhostTune. GhostBridge relays bytes transparently between a local WiFi TCP connection and its DB9 RS232 interface and can also serve compatible serial applications when the complete electrical, cabling, serial, and host-software requirements match.
column16: Compatibility:Verified configuration:GhostTune with MicroSquirt hardware running MS2/Extra 3.4.4
